records.label: headroom
records.sql: SELECT current_setting('max_connections'), count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='active') FROM pg_stat_activity

records.label: pristine
records.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "user"), (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace), (SELECT count(*) FROM issue), (SELECT count(*) FROM schema_migrations)

records.label: extensions
records.sql: SELECT name,default_version,installed_version FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name IN ('pg_bigm','pg_trgm','vector')

records.label: connections
records.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()
